illustration.description: Hand-drawn cartoon style with clean dark outlines, flat colors and a subtle paper grain. A young boy with messy brown hair and a worried, frowning expression leans forward and hunches as he walks. He wears a bright blue hoodie with white drawstrings and a front pocket, and his fists are clenched at his sides. Above his head hangs a grey metal dome lamp with a glowing yellow bulb, and his head is just under its rim. Soft warm light from the bulb, plain light background, no text.

texts.text: YOU WALK UNDER THINGS MORE CAREFULLY

texts.font: sans-serif, heavy italic (Rubik Italic or similar)
